item_name: Rothco Enhanced Molded Universal Radio Pouch
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Enhanced Molded Universal Radio Pouch is designed to keep your hand-held radio secure and accessible while you’re on the job. Featuring reliable snap closures, this military pouch ensures your radio stays in place, providing peace of mind during active duty. The 2-inch-wide belt loop on the back allows for easy attachment directly to your duty belt, making it a convenient and essential accessory for professionals who rely on their radio for communication.
description: Rothco’s Enhanced Molded Universal Radio Pouch is designed to keep your hand-held radio secure and accessible while you’re on the job. Featuring reliable snap closures, this military pouch ensures your radio stays in place, providing peace of mind during active duty. The 2-inch-wide belt loop on the back allows for easy attachment directly to your duty belt, making it a convenient and essential accessory for professionals who rely on their radio for communication. This universal radio pouch is designed to hold most hand-held radios, measuring 8 inch x 4 inch. It is lightweight yet durable, built to withstand the rigors of daily use in various demanding environments. Whether you’re a police officer, firefighter, security personnel, construction worker, or EMT, this pouch is an ideal choice to keep your radio secure and within reach.
